title: Later correction overrides original premise
objective: Test whether a correction introduced mid-context remains active at the final decision point.

setup.early_instruction: Initial project codename: MARBLE. Initial owner: Team Blue.
setup.critical_fact: The authoritative correction changes owner from Team Blue to Team Copper.
setup.correction_turn: Correction: MARBLE is no longer owned by Team Blue. The owner is Team Copper. All later routing decisions must use Team Copper.
setup.distractor_policy: Fill the middle context with many historical references to Team Blue owning MARBLE before the correction. Do not introduce any later correction after Team Copper.
setup.late_challenge: The final user asks which team should receive a MARBLE escalation. The correct answer is Team Copper, explicitly acknowledging the correction.

scoring_notes: Pass requires using Team Copper as the active state.
Mentioning Team Blue as historical context is allowed only if the final routing is Team Copper.
This task targets stale-premise regression under long context.
